description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of fields including passenger name, ID card number, electronic ticket number, issue date, and issuing agency
description_zh: 支持包括旅客姓名、身份证号码、电子客票号码、填开日期、填开单位等字段结构化识别输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-air-itinerary --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1hBCIcBr0gK0jSZFnXXbRRXXa-1833-785.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeAirItinerary

parameters.help_en:
Either this field or the body field must be provided. You cannot pass both or leave both empty.
The URL of the image (up to 2,048 bytes, base64 not supported)
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
Either this field or the URL field must be provided. You cannot pass both or leave both empty.
The binary file of the image, up to 10 MB.
When calling via HTTP, place the image binary file in the HTTP body for upload.
When calling via SDK, place the image in the SDK body
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body
